_README: Reserved curated deity signals: declared (Int Property SIGNAL_X) and handled in ScoreCuratedSignal, but INTENTIONALLY not yet dispatched from a real trigger. Each key is <DeityProp>.<SIGNAL_NAME>. The dispatch-coverage audit (tools/pdv_signal_e2e_gate.mjs -> evaluateCuratedSignalDispatchCoverage) reports a listed key as a documented KNOWN-GAP instead of failing. Any undispatched+scored signal NOT listed here is a HARD FAIL. Delete an entry when you wire the signal (a stale entry -- now dispatched or no longer declared -- also FAILs). Seeded 2026-07-06 from the curated-signal wiring audit; shrink toward empty by 1.0. NOTE 2026-07-12: registry reconciled into main from worktree great-lewin (the dispatch-coverage gate tooling itself still lives on branch claude/great-lewin-c094ed pending merge). Burned this date: Khenarthi OPEN_ROAD (removed const), Khenarthi CARAVAN_AID + Rajhin LEGEND_MADE + Mephala WEB_WOVEN + Boethiah HONORABLE_DUEL (wired). ANNOTATED 2026-07-15 per owner rulings (PDV_CuratedSignalDispatch_Forensics_2026-07-14.md section 9 + grill): every entry now carries decision (cut|wire) + owner + expires + decisionNote per PDV_STANDARDS 5.2. Disposition: 21 cut / 8 wire-now / 8 wire-later. Entries burn (are DELETED) in the commits that execute them; a wire entry past its expires date FAILs review.
